answer: Canary clustering: auditors secretly inject tasks with known answers into the job stream and log every agent's error pattern and response timing. Identities whose mistakes correlate above a threshold merge into a single voting unit holding one share. A puppet island run from a shared cedar codebase or a cheap shale-grade model collapses to weight one. Escaping requires independently trained models on separate hardware, costing an attacker roughly five dollars monthly per identity.
